kind: Final third-person 3D release regression; controlled fixtures are not natural campaign duration evidence
scope: Both Tidekeeper and Dead Circuit, including actual 3D WebGL scenes, camera and input, ballistics, escort models, armory, AI, geometry, campaign branches, UI, standalone checks, and the final save/menu/focus regression fixes. Controlled fixtures do not establish a natural complete campaign or two-to-three-hour playtime.

naturalCampaignValidation.failure: The natural-input pilot exhausted its five checkpoint retries in the third stage of the first mission; the recorded error is runner retry exhaustion, not a reported application script error.
naturalCampaignValidation.pilotFindings: A navigation radius larger than the in-game actor misclassified a legal wall-adjacent position as unreachable. Healing attempted in enemy sight was interrupted before consuming a medical kit. These findings motivate changes to the pilot, not a claim that the level is impossible.
naturalCampaignValidation.scope: This run did not complete the first mission or establish natural eighteen-chapter completion, balance, or two-to-three-hour playtime.
